mapper.select: /* apiDefReg.selDefListByApiSpcNo */ SELECT d.api_no AS "apiNo" ,c.ctgry_nm AS "ctgryNm" ,d.api_nm AS "apiNm" ,d.api_path AS "apiPath" ,d.method_cd AS "methodCd" FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF d LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_CTGRY c ON c.API_CTGRY_NO = d.API_CTGRY_NO WHERE d.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer ORDER BY c.SORT_ODRG, d.SORT_ODRG

/* apiDefReg.selApiDefDetail */ SELECT api_no AS "apiNo" ,COALESCE(api_id, '') AS "apiId" ,COALESCE(api_ver, '') AS "apiVer" ,api_ver_no AS "apiVerNo" ,COALESCE(bstgw_tb_sys_id, '') AS "bstgwTbSysId" ,COALESCE(bstgw_prd_sys_id, '') AS "bstgwPrdSysId" ,api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,api_ctgry_no AS "apiCtgryNo" ,api_nm AS "apiNm" ,api_desc AS "apiDesc" ,api_path AS "apiPath" ,method_cd AS "methodCd" ,api_gubun AS "apiClass" ,api_handler_cd AS "apiHandlerCd" ,provider_seq AS "providerSeq" ,COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') AS "useYn" ,COALESCE(guide_gubun, '') AS "guideGubun" ,COALESCE(sandbox_yn, 'N') AS "sandboxYn" ,COALESCE(endpnt_method_cd, '') AS "endpntMethodCd" ,endpnt_tb_url AS "endpntTbUrl" ,endpnt_prd_url AS "endpntPrdUrl" ,endpnt_client_ip AS "endpntClientIp" ,endpnt_timeout AS "endpntTimeout" ,resmap_res_cd_field AS "resmapResCdField" ,resmap_succ_val AS "resmapSuccVal" ,resmap_err_cd_field AS "resmapErrCdField" ,resmap_err_msg_field AS "resmapErrMsgField" ,hdp_api_endpoint_id AS "hdpApiEndpointId" ,hdp_req_api_name AS "hdpReqApiName" ,hdp_api_out_format AS "hdpApiOutFormat" ,hdp_api_out_common_param AS "hdpApiOutCommonParam" ,hdp_req_mapping_to_body AS "hdpReqMappingToBody" ,hdp_res_mapping_to_body AS "hdpResMappingToBody" ,COALESCE(hdp_req_config_to_body, '') AS "hdpReqConfigToBody" ,COALESCE(hdp_req_header_to_body, '') AS "hdpReqHeaderToBody" ,COALESCE(hdp_res_provide_param, '') AS "hdpResProvideParam" ,COALESCE(hdp_req_url_decode, '') AS "hdpReqUrlDecode" ,COALESCE(hdp_req_url_encode, '') AS "hdpReqUrlEncode" ,COALESCE(hdp_res_url_encode, '') AS "hdpResUrlEncode" ,COALESCE(hdp_hndlroptn_config, '') AS "hdpHndlroptnConfig" ,COALESCE(hdp_ext_prop, '') AS "hdpExtProp" FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer

/* apiDefReg.selParamListByApiNo */ SELECT param_no AS "paramNo" ,param_nm AS "paramNm" ,data_type_cd AS "dataTypeCd" ,required AS "required" ,param_desc AS "paramDesc" ,param_loc AS "paramLoc" ,param_type_cd AS "paramTypeCd" ,sort_odrg AS "sortOdrg" ,prnts_param_no AS "prntsParamNo" ,obj_no AS "objNo" ,obj_odrg AS "objOdrg" ,exam AS "exam" ,personal_data AS "personalData" ,COALESCE(do_not_send, '') AS "doNotSend" ,COALESCE(fixed_value, '') AS "fixedValue" ,COALESCE(hidden, '') AS "hidden" ,COALESCE(mapping_key, '') AS "mappingKey" ,COALESCE(bigo, '') AS "bigo" ,COALESCE(param_sandbox_yn, '') AS "paramSandboxYn" ,COALESCE(hdp_url_decode, '') AS "hdpUrlDecode" ,COALESCE(hdp_url_encode, '') AS "hdpUrlEncode" ,COALESCE(hdp_upload_target, '') AS "hdpUploadTarget" ,COALESCE(res_cd, '') AS "resCd" ,COALESCE(res_desc, '') AS "resDesc" FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer ORDER BY SORT_ODRG, PARAM_NO

/* apiDefReg.selSpcByNo */ SELECT s.api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,s.api_nm AS "spcNm" ,s.sys_id AS "sysId" ,s.host AS "host" ,s.bas_path AS "basPath" ,s.ver AS "ver" ,COALESCE(s.bstgw_yn, 'N') AS "bstgwYn" FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s WHERE s.DEL_YN = 'N' AND s.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer
/* apiDefReg.selDefaultCtgryBySpc */ SELECT API_CTGRY_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY WHERE API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY API_CTGRY_NO LIMIT 1
mapper.update: /* apiDefReg.updApiVerNoSelf */ UPDATE KOA_TB_API_DEF SET API_VER_NO = #{apiNo}::integer WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer
mapper.select: /* apiDefReg.selTmpltList */ SELECT tmplt_no AS "tmpltNo" ,tmplt_nm AS "tmpltNm" ,COALESCE(tmplt_desc, '') AS "tmpltDesc" ,api_class AS "apiClass" ,mth_type_cd AS "mthTypeCd" ,COALESCE(path_pattern, '') AS "pathPattern" ,COALESCE(dflt_param_json, '') AS "dfltParamJson" ,COALESCE(dflt_field_json, '') AS "dfltFieldJson" ,sort_odrg AS "sortOdrg" FROM KOA_TB_API_QUICK_TMPLT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ODRG, TMPLT_NO

/* apiDefReg.selApiProviderList */ SELECT pvd.SEQ AS "seq" ,pvd.PROVIDER_NM AS "providerNm" ,COALESCE(pvd.eStdSvcCode, '') AS "eStdSvcCode" FROM KOA_TB_API_PROVIDER pvd WHERE pvd.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(pvd.SORT_ODRG, 999), pvd.PROVIDER_NM, pvd.SEQ

/* apiDefReg.selNextApiId */ SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT 'OIF_' || LPAD((CAST(SUBSTRING(MAX(API_ID) FROM 5) AS INTEGER) + 1)::text, 5, '0') FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE API_ID ~ '^OIF_[0-9]{5}$') , 'OIF_00001')

/* apiDefReg.selBstSysList */ SELECT as_item.SYS_ID AS "sysId" ,as_item.SYS_NM AS "sysNm" ,COALESCE(as_item.EDPT_ATRIB_URL, '') AS "edptAtribUrl" FROM
BST_SYNC_TB_AZURE_ADM_SYS_DPLY as_item BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY as_item BST_SYNC_AZURE_ADM_SYS_DPLY as_item BST_SYNC_TB_ADM_SYS_DPLY as_item
WHERE as_item.DPLY_TYPE = 'DPLY'
AND UPPER(as_item.SYS_ID) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{sysId}), '%')
AND UPPER(as_item.SYS_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{sysNm}), '%')
ORDER BY as_item.SYS_ID LIMIT 200
mapper.delete: /* apiDefReg.delParamsByApiNo */ DELETE FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer AND PARAM_TYPE_CD IN ('PRMTYP1010', 'PRMTYP1020')
